statements.statement: The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The diagnosis codes submitted were I48.0 and I47.1
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to accurately characterize the frequency and duration of arrhythmic events for optimal management
